summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle at install time
details: The package.json preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts and chmods the binary, and then execs `bun math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (obfuscator.io-style string-array rotator `WV8StW`, large numeric constant table `n7gIxM`, `_0x`-mangled identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that sits at the tarball root and is not listed in the package.json `files` allowlist (which declares only `dist` and `src`). The advertised functionality is a small schema-diff CLI in `dist/app.js`, unrelated to any need for a separate JavaScript runtime. Fetching Bun and then using it to execute an opaque, obfuscated bundle at `npm install` time evades Node-based inspection and provides arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine under the alien runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
